senses.definition_en: friend with benefits

examples.english: The only person close to him is Frau Bow, a kind of friend with benefits who doesn't hesitate to warn about the crisis her mate is undergoing: […]
examples.ref: 1995, “Mobile Suit Gundam III”, in RAN: Ultrafanzine de manga & anime, number 7, Argentina, page 53:
examples.text: La única persona allegada a él es Frau Bow, una especie de amigovia que no tarda en advertir la crisis por la que su compañero esta atravesando: […]
examples.translation: The only person close to him is Frau Bow, a kind of friend with benefits who doesn't hesitate to warn about the crisis her mate is undergoing: […]

examples.english: The first day I'm with my current 'friend with benefits she seems to me the prettiest in the world, the sexiest, the most glamorous, the most interesting, the smartest, the most amiable.
examples.ref: 1995, Gustavo Ekroth, “Menamoromembolo”, in Las (des)parejas del Uruguay, Uruguay: Editorial Fin de Siglo, →ISBN, page 110:
examples.text: El primer día que estoy con mi amigovia de turno me parece la indígena más linda del mundo, la más sensual, la más glamorosa, la más interesante, la más inteligente, la más simpática.
examples.translation: The first day I'm with my current 'friend with benefits she seems to me the prettiest in the world, the sexiest, the most glamorous, the most interesting, the smartest, the most amiable.

examples.english: Some time later, he and I stopped seeing each other. On May 2, 1945 my friend with benefits took his own life.
examples.ref: 2016, Dora Margarita Villafañe de Gil, “La adolescencia” (chapter 3), in La lechuza y la mariposa, Argentina, page 54:
examples.text: Tiempo después, él y yo dejamos de frecuentarnos. El 2 de mayo de 1945 mi amigovio se quitó la vida.
examples.translation: Some time later, he and I stopped seeing each other. On May 2, 1945 my friend with benefits took his own life.
